1. Heard Sri Dharmendra Kumar Gupta, Advocate, holding brief of Sri Narendra Gupta, the learned counsel for the applicant as well as Sri Manoj Kumar Sahu, the learned A.G.A. for the State and perused the record.

2. The instant application has been filed seeking release of the applicant on bail in Case Crime No.
129 of 2022, under Sections 363, 366, 376, 346, 506 I.P.C. and Section 3/4 of Protection of Children from Sexual Offences Act, registered at Police Station Sidhauli, District Sitapur.

entities.text: Protection of Children from Sexual Offences Act
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: 3. The aforesaid case has been registered on the basis of F.I.R. lodged on 11.04.2022 stating that the informant's daughter aged about 16 years did not return from her college.
4. In the statement of the victim recorded under Section 161 Cr.P.C., she stated that she loves the applicant for the past two years and she has married him on 12.09.2022.
She categorically stated that she loves the applicant and she wants to live with him only.

In the statement of the victim recorded under Section 164 Cr.P.C, she stated that she was taken away forcibly and was married to the applicant.
6. Some photographs annexed with the affidavit filed in support of the bail application indicates that the applicant and the victim were in an affectionate relationship.
7. The victim was taken for her medico-legal examination, but she declined to undergo the same.
8. In the affidavit filed in support of the bail application, it has been stated that the applicant is innocent, he has been falsely implicated in the present case and he has no criminal history.
9. The learned A.G.A. has opposed the prayer of the bail, but he could not dispute the aforesaid aspects of the matter.

10. Having considered the aforesaid facts and circumstances of the case and keeping in view the fact that the victim has stated that she loves the applicant and she has married him; that she has declined to undergo the medico legal examination, coupled with the fact that the applicant has no criminal history and he is languishing in jail since 04.05.2022 and without making any observations which may affect the merits of the case, I am of the view that the aforesaid facts are sufficient for making out a case for enlargement of the applicant on bail.
11. Accordingly, this bail application stands allowed.

12. Let the applicant- Sachin be released on bail in Case Crime No. 129 of 2022, under Sections 363,
366, 376, 346, 506 I.P.C. and Section 3/4 of Protection of Children from Sexual Offences Act,
registered at Police Station Sidhauli, District Sitapur, on furnishing a personal bond and two sureties each in the like amount to the satisfaction of Magistrate/Court concerned, subject to the following conditions: -
(i) the applicant shall not tamper with the prosecution evidence;
(ii) the applicant shall not pressurize the prosecution witnesses;
(iii) the applicant shall appear on each and every date fixed by the trial court.
In case of breach of any of the above conditions, the prosecution shall be at liberty to move bail cancellation application before this Court.
